top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises a documented, mature chain of discovery: proglucagon processing and the incretin effect (Holst), the biologically active GLP-1(7-36) peptide (Mojsov) and receptor and tissue biology (Drucker). It is confirmed by independent outcome trials on glycaemic, weight, cardiovascular and renal endpoints. A citation centred on the physiology and the active peptide describes what these three did without claiming to reward drug development. The omission of Knudsen under the three-person cap and the unresolved Mojsov versus Habener priority are real weaknesses, but they do not outweigh the case, and no award is clearly worse than this achievement.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; no documented tie to the GLP-1 laureates, though the profile notes shared institutional and co-authorship links with other committee members that are not relevant here
